title: KDE Plasma built-in Klipper saves clipboard history to Disk and only clears them on exit
line: With "Save history across desktop sessions" off, copied text is no longer written to disk; the history lives only in memory.
explanation: Since the SQLite port, Klipper always used the on-disk history3.sqlite database and ~/.local/share/klipper/data, even with "Save history across desktop sessions" off, and only wiped them at startup and exit. Every copied text therefore sat on disk (also in the WAL, which keeps it after clearing) for the whole session. Now, when history isn't kept, Klipper uses an in-memory SQLite database and keeps item data in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/klipper (tmpfs, removed on exit), and deletes any leftover on-disk history at startup. Turning the option on at runtime copies the session's history to disk (VACUUM INTO + data files); turning it off clears it and removes the disk files.

commits.message:
klipper: keep history off disk when it is not saved across sessions

With "Save history across desktop sessions" off, every copied text still
went into the on-disk database, its WAL and the data folder. Use an
in-memory database and a data folder in the runtime directory instead.

BUG: 501030

media.caption: Master, option off: the copied text is found in history3.sqlite-wal and in a file under ~/.local/share/klipper/data
With the fix, option off: the text is in the clipboard history but nowhere under ~/.local/share/klipper
